text: At the 1896 Summer Olympics, three fencing events were held at the Zappeion and organized by the Sub-Committee for Fencing. The men's épée event was cancelled. All matches were conducted to three touches, with events taking place on 7 April and 9 April 1896. A total of 15 fencers from four nations participated. Eight fencers from three nations each won one medal. These medals were retroactively assigned by the International Olympic Committee; at the time, medal winners were awarded silver.
